title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Underwriting Rule for the Mandatory Purchase Amount and Certificate Limits
content:
Under the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs**, the amount of building coverage a certificate carries is set as follows.

**Mandatory purchase amount.** The mandatory purchase amount (required amount) is the lowest of the loan's outstanding principal balance, the tier's NFIP maximum building reference and the building's insurable value. **This sentence is no longer in force for a placement priced under the residential placement schedule or the commercial placement schedule, each of which takes the amount from the loan's latest first notice, nor for a renewal priced under the residential renewal schedule, which follows its renewal-notice rule; for every other certificate the mandatory purchase amount remains the lowest of those three figures.**

**Building limit by method.** The tier's method decides the building limit:

| Method of the tier | Building limit before rounding |
|---|---|
| Mandatory purchase amount | The required amount |
| Gap to the mandatory purchase amount | The required amount less the building limit of the borrower's own policy in force |
| Replacement cost | The insurable value |

In every method the limit is rounded up to the next multiple of the tier's limit rounding increment and capped at the tier's highest certificate building limit, and when the result is below the tier's lowest certificate building limit no certificate is issued.

**Contents.** A contents limit is placed only on a tier that places contents coverage and only when business contents secure the loan, equal to the secured contents value capped at the tier's highest contents limit.

**At renewal.** The amount is recomputed from the balances reported at each renewal. **This sentence is no longer in force for a renewal on the Residential Mandatory Amount tier, which takes its amount under the residential renewal schedule; at the renewal of every other certificate the amount is still recomputed from the balances reported at that renewal.**

The tier figures this rule reads (method, NFIP maximum building reference, highest and lowest building limits, rounding increment, contents availability and highest contents limit) are those of the product's certificate limit schedule for each tier.

## Hypothetical illustration (Gap method)

Hypothetical inputs: required amount 87,450 dollars; borrower's own policy building limit 50,000 dollars. Limit before rounding: 37,450 dollars. Rounded up to the next multiple of a hypothetical 100-dollar increment it is 37,500 dollars, which is then capped at the tier's highest certificate building limit; had the result fallen below the tier's lowest certificate building limit, no certificate would be issued.

superseded_clauses: The mandatory purchase amount (required_amount) is the lowest of the loan's outstanding principal balance, the tier's nfip_max_building_reference and the building's insurable value.
The amount is recomputed from the balances reported at each renewal.
